title: Patch: a socket that closed before the first view says the game is gone, not 'Joining…'
thread:
**Issue #1599 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1599: Patch: a socket that closed before the first view says the game is gone, not 'Joining…' Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means If a match or co-op stream closes for good before the first game screen arrives — the match was voided, the connection gave up — the player today stares at a 'Joining the match…' spinner forever: a dead end dressed as a loading state. After the fix the screen says plainly that the game isn't available and offers the way back, like the existing 'This match isn't available' panel for refused joins. ## Why On the match, co-op and watch routes, `view === null` falls through to `` for every connection state except `refused` (`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:317-346`, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx:195-217`, `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx:208-216`). A `closed` connection with no view received is terminal — a voided match close (`VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE` 4410, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts:704-706`) or exhausted watch reconnects (~10 s) — but is presented as pending; on the watch route the connection words aren't even rendered in that branch. ## Proposal Add a `connection === "closed" && view === null` branch per route rendering a terminal notice plus the way back, mirroring the `refused` panel. The watch route overlaps the open retry issue #1570 — if that lands first, this keeps the match and co-op halves; the terminal-notice shape is the same either way. ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`, `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts` (the existing close code). ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Vitest with a fake socket: close with the voided code on match and co-op, or exhaust the watch reconnects, and assert a terminal notice and back link render instead of the Joining copy. - [ ] The `refused` panel and normal joining flow are unchanged. ## Size and risks Small, three route files. Care only to keep #1570's watcher-retry wording compatible; the match and co-op halves are unclaimed by it. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39707256337)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal On `/match/`, `/duos/` and `/watch/`, a socket that is `closed` before the first view no longer shows the "Joining …" spinner. It shows a terminal notice (`role="alert"`) and the way back, built like each route's existing `refused` panel. On the match and co-op routes that state is the voided close (`VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE` 4410, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`). On the watch route it is the reopens running out, and #1570's "Reconnect now" (already on `main` as #1604) stays on the new panel. The `refused` panels, the joining flow and every existing test stay as they are. ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` | change | `matchTestid.gone`; a `closed` branch in `MatchRoute`'s `view === null` block | | `apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts` | change | `duosTestid.gone` | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx` | change | a `closed` branch in `DuosRoute`'s `view === null` block | | `apps/web/src/together/testids.ts` | change | `watchTestid.gone`, plus a doc line on `waiting` | | `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx` | change | header sentence; a `view === null && connection === "closed"` branch in `WatchRoute`; the now-unreachable `exhausted` button leaves the Loading branch | | `e2e/support/testids.ts` | change | `WATCH_GONE` mirror (the file mirrors `watchTestid`) | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | three new sentences (R711000's i18n test requires them) | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change | one new test | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx` | change | one new test | | `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx` | change | one new test | Do not touch `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts` or any other file under `crates/`, `spec/`, `e2e/cypress/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. No spec section governs this client copy, so it needs no ruling. It changes no catalog, so it needs no patch fragment. CLAUDE.md rule 7 holds: the routes only show the connection state the socket reported. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `matchTestid`.** Add this right after `refused: "match-refused",`: ```ts /** #1599: the sentence that stands in for a socket closed for good before any view (a voided match). */ gone: "match-gone", ``` 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `MatchRoute`.** In `if (view === null) {`, put a second `if` after the closing `}` of `if (match.connection === "refused") { … }` and before the `// Render's free tier…` comment: ```tsx // #1599: a socket closed for good before any view (a voided match's VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, game/net.ts) // has nothing left to wait for, so the panel says so rather than Joining. if (match.connection === "closed") { return (

{t("This match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.")}

{t("Back to the lobby")}
); } ``` The panel has no Reconnect now, because a voided match has no socket to reconnect to (R679, already cited in net.ts). 3. **`apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts`.** Add `gone: "duos-gone",` right after `refused: "duos-refused",`, with the comment `/** #1599: the sentence that stands in for a socket closed for good before any view (a voided match). */` above it. 4. **`apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`, `DuosRoute`.** Do the same as step 2, after the `refused` `if` block and before `return (

{t("This co-op match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.")}

{t("Back to Play together")}
); } ``` 5. **`apps/web/src/together/testids.ts`, `watchTestid`.** - Put `/** The panel before the first view: the wait, or (#1599) the notice that the reopens ran out. */` above `waiting: "watch-waiting",`. - Add this after `refused: "watch-refused",`: ```ts /** #1599: the sentence that stands in for the wait once the reopens ran out before any view. */ gone: "watch-gone", ``` 6. **`e2e/support/testids.ts`.** Add `export const WATCH_GONE = "watch-gone";` right after `export const WATCH_REFUSED = "watch-refused";`. 7. **`apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx`.** - In the header comment, add this to the end of the sentence that ends `…and starts the attempts over (#1570).`: ` Run out before the first view, the screen says the game can no longer be reached rather than waiting on (#1599).` Rewrap the comment to the lines around it. - In `WatchRoute`, put a new branch between `if (connection === "refused") { … }` and `} else if (view === null) {`: ```tsx } else if (view === null && connection === "closed") { // #1599: the reopens ran out before any view; a spinner here would be a dead end. screen = (

{t("This game can no longer be reached. It may be over, or the connection gave up.")}

); ``` - In the `view === null` Loading branch below it, delete the line `{exhausted ? : null}`. It cannot be reached any more, because the new branch handles every `closed` state before a view. Leave `
` as it is. - Leave `exhausted` and the board branch unchanged. - The panel keeps `watchTestid.waiting` so that #1570's test `"#1570 offers Reconnect now on the waiting panel when no view came…"` (`WatchRoute.test.tsx`) still passes unchanged. 8. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`.** Add three entries, each with a trailing comma, keeping the JSON valid: - After `"This match isn’t available. It may have ended, or it may not be yours to join.": …,`: `"This match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.": "这场对局已不可用。它在棋盘加载前就已关闭。",` - After `"This co-op match isn’t available. It may have ended, or it may not be yours to join.": …,`: `"This co-op match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.": "这场合作对局已不可用。它在棋盘加载前就已关闭。",` - After `"Joining as a watcher…": …,`: `"This game can no longer be reached. It may be over, or the connection gave up.": "已无法连接到这场对局。它可能已经结束，或者连接已中断。",` The keys must match the `t()` strings exactly. None of the three has an apostrophe. ## Tests 1. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`.** - Change `import type { SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";` to `import { VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, type SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";`. - In `describe("the match screen in a player's words", …)`, after the test `"says a refused match isn't available, …"`, add `it("#1599 a match voided before the first view says it is gone and offers the lobby, not Joining", …)`. It does the following: - Render ``. - Assert `screen.getByTestId("match-connecting")` has the text `"Joining the match…"`, so the joining flow is unchanged. - Run `act(() => { live().onclose?.({ code: VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, reason: "voided", wasClean: true }); })`. - Assert `getByTestId("match-gone")` has the text `"This match is no longer available."`. - Assert `getByTestId("match-connecting")` no longer has the text `"Joining the match…"`. - Assert `queryByTestId("gate-loading")`, `queryByTestId("match-refused")` and `queryByTestId("match-reconnect")` are all null. - Assert `getByRole("link", { name: "Back to the lobby" })` has the attribute `href` `"/play"`. - Assert `sockets` has length 1, so it does not reconnect. 2. **`apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx`.** - Change `import type { SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";` to `import { VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, type SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";`. - Add a new `describe("the co-op route before its first view", …)` with `it("#1599 a co-op match voided before the first view says it is gone and offers Play together, not Joining", …)`. It does the following: - Render ``. - Assert `getByTestId(duosTestid.connecting)` has the text `"Joining the co-op match…"`. - Run `act(() => { latest().onclose?.({ code: VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, reason: "", wasClean: true }); })`. - Assert `getByTestId(duosTestid.gone)` has the text `"This co-op match is no longer available."`. - Assert the connecting panel no longer has the text `"Joining the co-op match…"`. - Assert `queryByTestId("gate-loading")`, `queryByTestId(duosTestid.refused)` and `queryByTestId(duosTestid.reconnect)` are all null. - Assert `getByRole("link", { name: "Back to Play together" })` has `href` `"/together"`. - Assert `sockets` has length 1. 3. **`apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx`.** At the end of `describe("B50 the watch screen", …)`, add `it("#1599 once the reopens run out before any view, says the game can no longer be reached, with Reconnect now and the way back, not Joining", async () => …)`. It does the following: - Run `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setTimeout", "clearTimeout"] })`, then `watch()`. - Assert `getByTestId("watch-waiting")` has the text `"Joining as a watcher…"`. - Loop `for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= WATCH_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1)`. In each pass, call `latest().emit("close")`, assert `queryByTestId("watch-gone")` is null, then run `await advance(WATCH_RECONNECT_MS)`. - After the loop, call `latest().emit("close")` once more. - Assert `connection("watch-screen")` is `"closed"`. - Assert `getByTestId("watch-gone")` has the text `"This game can no longer be reached."`. - Let `panel = getByTestId("watch-waiting")`. Assert it does not have the text `"Joining as a watcher…"`. - Assert `queryByTestId("gate-loading")` and `queryByTestId("watch-refused")` are null. - Assert `panel` contains `getByTestId("watch-back")`, whose `href` is `"/together"`, and also contains `getByTestId("watch-reconnect")`. Run these: ``` sh scripts/build-wasm.sh pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/match.test.tsx src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e pnpm --dir apps/web test ``` ## Done when - [ ] Match and co-op: a 4410 close before the first view shows the `*-gone` notice and a back link, and no "Joining" copy. - [ ] Watch: running out of reopens before the first view shows `watch-gone`, Reconnect now and Back, and no "Joining" copy. - [ ] Every existing test in the three route test files passes unchanged. That covers the refused panels, the waiting panel and Reconnect now on the holding panel (match, and #1570's watch test). - [ ] The three new tests pass, and so does `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`. - [ ] The web typecheck, eslint, the full web unit suite, and the harness's checks (rustfmt through web tests) are green, with no Rust file changed. ## Risks - **A transient `closed` shows the notice.** On match and co-op only a 4410 or `close()` sets `closed`. React StrictMode's cleanup-then-connect runs within one commit and ends `connecting`, and an unmount renders nothing. Do not add any other trigger. - **#1570's watch test.** It asserts `watch-waiting` contains `watch-reconnect` when no view came. Step 7 keeps that testid on the new panel, so do not rename it. - **i18n.** Every new `t()` literal needs its exact `zh-CN.json` key, curly quotes included. The plan's strings avoid apostrophes on purpose. - **e2e.** `44-watch.cy.ts` asserts `WATCH_WAITING` only while `open`, so nothing in e2e changes behaviour. ## Open questions None for a person. The planner made these decisions: - The match and co-op notices offer no Reconnect now, because R679 leaves a voided match nothing to reconnect to. The alternative, a retry button, was rejected. - The watch notice keeps #1570's Reconnect now and the `watch-waiting` panel testid. A new panel testid that would have meant editing #1570's test was rejected. - `net.ts`'s `ConnectionState` doc for `"closed"` (`` `close()` was called. ``) is left as it is. Editing it was out of scope. - `apps/web/README.md` stays as it is, because its route table names no before-view panel. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-22T01:39:42Z: Approve ````

## Goal On `/match/`, `/duos/` and `/watch/`, a socket that is `closed` before the first view no longer shows the "Joining …" spinner. It shows a terminal notice (`role="alert"`) and the way back, built like each route's existing `refused` panel. On the match and co-op routes that state is the voided close (`VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE` 4410, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`). On the watch route it is the reopens running out, and #1570's "Reconnect now" (already on `main` as #1604) stays on the new panel. The `refused` panels, the joining flow and every existing test stay as they are. ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` | change | `matchTestid.gone`; a `closed` branch in `MatchRoute`'s `view === null` block | | `apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts` | change | `duosTestid.gone` | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx` | change | a `closed` branch in `DuosRoute`'s `view === null` block | | `apps/web/src/together/testids.ts` | change | `watchTestid.gone`, plus a doc line on `waiting` | | `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx` | change | header sentence; a `view === null && connection === "closed"` branch in `WatchRoute`; the now-unreachable `exhausted` button leaves the Loading branch | | `e2e/support/testids.ts` | change | `WATCH_GONE` mirror (the file mirrors `watchTestid`) | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | three new sentences (R711000's i18n test requires them) | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change | one new test | | `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx` | change | one new test | | `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx` | change | one new test | Do not touch `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts` or any other file under `crates/`, `spec/`, `e2e/cypress/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. No spec section governs this client copy, so it needs no ruling. It changes no catalog, so it needs no patch fragment. CLAUDE.md rule 7 holds: the routes only show the connection state the socket reported. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `matchTestid`.** Add this right after `refused: "match-refused",`: ```ts /** #1599: the sentence that stands in for a socket closed for good before any view (a voided match). */ gone: "match-gone", ``` 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `MatchRoute`.** In `if (view === null) {`, put a second `if` after the closing `}` of `if (match.connection === "refused") { … }` and before the `// Render's free tier…` comment: ```tsx // #1599: a socket closed for good before any view (a voided match's VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, game/net.ts) // has nothing left to wait for, so the panel says so rather than Joining. if (match.connection === "closed") { return (

{t("This match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.")}

{t("Back to the lobby")}
); } ``` The panel has no Reconnect now, because a voided match has no socket to reconnect to (R679, already cited in net.ts). 3. **`apps/web/src/duos/testids.ts`.** Add `gone: "duos-gone",` right after `refused: "duos-refused",`, with the comment `/** #1599: the sentence that stands in for a socket closed for good before any view (a voided match). */` above it. 4. **`apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`, `DuosRoute`.** Do the same as step 2, after the `refused` `if` block and before `return (

{t("This co-op match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.")}

{t("Back to Play together")}
); } ``` 5. **`apps/web/src/together/testids.ts`, `watchTestid`.** - Put `/** The panel before the first view: the wait, or (#1599) the notice that the reopens ran out. */` above `waiting: "watch-waiting",`. - Add this after `refused: "watch-refused",`: ```ts /** #1599: the sentence that stands in for the wait once the reopens ran out before any view. */ gone: "watch-gone", ``` 6. **`e2e/support/testids.ts`.** Add `export const WATCH_GONE = "watch-gone";` right after `export const WATCH_REFUSED = "watch-refused";`. 7. **`apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx`.** - In the header comment, add this to the end of the sentence that ends `…and starts the attempts over (#1570).`: ` Run out before the first view, the screen says the game can no longer be reached rather than waiting on (#1599).` Rewrap the comment to the lines around it. - In `WatchRoute`, put a new branch between `if (connection === "refused") { … }` and `} else if (view === null) {`: ```tsx } else if (view === null && connection === "closed") { // #1599: the reopens ran out before any view; a spinner here would be a dead end. screen = (

{t("This game can no longer be reached. It may be over, or the connection gave up.")}

); ``` - In the `view === null` Loading branch below it, delete the line `{exhausted ? : null}`. It cannot be reached any more, because the new branch handles every `closed` state before a view. Leave `
` as it is. - Leave `exhausted` and the board branch unchanged. - The panel keeps `watchTestid.waiting` so that #1570's test `"#1570 offers Reconnect now on the waiting panel when no view came…"` (`WatchRoute.test.tsx`) still passes unchanged. 8. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`.** Add three entries, each with a trailing comma, keeping the JSON valid: - After `"This match isn’t available. It may have ended, or it may not be yours to join.": …,`: `"This match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.": "这场对局已不可用。它在棋盘加载前就已关闭。",` - After `"This co-op match isn’t available. It may have ended, or it may not be yours to join.": …,`: `"This co-op match is no longer available. It closed before the board could load.": "这场合作对局已不可用。它在棋盘加载前就已关闭。",` - After `"Joining as a watcher…": …,`: `"This game can no longer be reached. It may be over, or the connection gave up.": "已无法连接到这场对局。它可能已经结束，或者连接已中断。",` The keys must match the `t()` strings exactly. None of the three has an apostrophe. ## Tests 1. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`.** - Change `import type { SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";` to `import { VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, type SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";`. - In `describe("the match screen in a player's words", …)`, after the test `"says a refused match isn't available, …"`, add `it("#1599 a match voided before the first view says it is gone and offers the lobby, not Joining", …)`. It does the following: - Render ``. - Assert `screen.getByTestId("match-connecting")` has the text `"Joining the match…"`, so the joining flow is unchanged. - Run `act(() => { live().onclose?.({ code: VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, reason: "voided", wasClean: true }); })`. - Assert `getByTestId("match-gone")` has the text `"This match is no longer available."`. - Assert `getByTestId("match-connecting")` no longer has the text `"Joining the match…"`. - Assert `queryByTestId("gate-loading")`, `queryByTestId("match-refused")` and `queryByTestId("match-reconnect")` are all null. - Assert `getByRole("link", { name: "Back to the lobby" })` has the attribute `href` `"/play"`. - Assert `sockets` has length 1, so it does not reconnect. 2. **`apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx`.** - Change `import type { SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";` to `import { VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, type SocketLike } from "../game/net.ts";`. - Add a new `describe("the co-op route before its first view", …)` with `it("#1599 a co-op match voided before the first view says it is gone and offers Play together, not Joining", …)`. It does the following: - Render ``. - Assert `getByTestId(duosTestid.connecting)` has the text `"Joining the co-op match…"`. - Run `act(() => { latest().onclose?.({ code: VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, reason: "", wasClean: true }); })`. - Assert `getByTestId(duosTestid.gone)` has the text `"This co-op match is no longer available."`. - Assert the connecting panel no longer has the text `"Joining the co-op match…"`. - Assert `queryByTestId("gate-loading")`, `queryByTestId(duosTestid.refused)` and `queryByTestId(duosTestid.reconnect)` are all null. - Assert `getByRole("link", { name: "Back to Play together" })` has `href` `"/together"`. - Assert `sockets` has length 1. 3. **`apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx`.** At the end of `describe("B50 the watch screen", …)`, add `it("#1599 once the reopens run out before any view, says the game can no longer be reached, with Reconnect now and the way back, not Joining", async () => …)`. It does the following: - Run `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setTimeout", "clearTimeout"] })`, then `watch()`. - Assert `getByTestId("watch-waiting")` has the text `"Joining as a watcher…"`. - Loop `for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= WATCH_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1)`. In each pass, call `latest().emit("close")`, assert `queryByTestId("watch-gone")` is null, then run `await advance(WATCH_RECONNECT_MS)`. - After the loop, call `latest().emit("close")` once more. - Assert `connection("watch-screen")` is `"closed"`. - Assert `getByTestId("watch-gone")` has the text `"This game can no longer be reached."`. - Let `panel = getByTestId("watch-waiting")`. Assert it does not have the text `"Joining as a watcher…"`. - Assert `queryByTestId("gate-loading")` and `queryByTestId("watch-refused")` are null. - Assert `panel` contains `getByTestId("watch-back")`, whose `href` is `"/together"`, and also contains `getByTestId("watch-reconnect")`. Run these: ``` sh scripts/build-wasm.sh pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/match.test.tsx src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx src/together/WatchRoute.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e pnpm --dir apps/web test ``` ## Done when - [ ] Match and co-op: a 4410 close before the first view shows the `*-gone` notice and a back link, and no "Joining" copy. - [ ] Watch: running out of reopens before the first view shows `watch-gone`, Reconnect now and Back, and no "Joining" copy. - [ ] Every existing test in the three route test files passes unchanged. That covers the refused panels, the waiting panel and Reconnect now on the holding panel (match, and #1570's watch test). - [ ] The three new tests pass, and so does `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`. - [ ] The web typecheck, eslint, the full web unit suite, and the harness's checks (rustfmt through web tests) are green, with no Rust file changed. ## Risks - **A transient `closed` shows the notice.** On match and co-op only a 4410 or `close()` sets `closed`. React StrictMode's cleanup-then-connect runs within one commit and ends `connecting`, and an unmount renders nothing. Do not add any other trigger. - **#1570's watch test.** It asserts `watch-waiting` contains `watch-reconnect` when no view came. Step 7 keeps that testid on the new panel, so do not rename it. - **i18n.** Every new `t()` literal needs its exact `zh-CN.json` key, curly quotes included. The plan's strings avoid apostrophes on purpose. - **e2e.** `44-watch.cy.ts` asserts `WATCH_WAITING` only while `open`, so nothing in e2e changes behaviour. ## Open questions None for a person. The planner made these decisions: - The match and co-op notices offer no Reconnect now, because R679 leaves a voided match nothing to reconnect to. The alternative, a retry button, was rejected. - The watch notice keeps #1570's Reconnect now and the `watch-waiting` panel testid. A new panel testid that would have meant editing #1570's test was rejected. - `net.ts`'s `ConnectionState` doc for `"closed"` (`` `close()` was called. ``) is left as it is. Editing it was out of scope. - `apps/web/README.md` stays as it is, because its route table names no before-view panel.
